_review: NEEDS_HUMAN_REVIEW: placeholder wording for the chat screen, including the voice privacy note. The banner, limits and voice notice must be reviewed by a clinician and a lawyer (docs/review-needed.md R9, R12, R28), R31 (what Sushi may see).
title: Sushi
banner: I am an AI, not a therapist.
retentionTitle: What happens to what you write
limits: Replies are short. It can talk things through with you, but it is an AI and can get things wrong. There is a daily limit on AI replies.
supportHint: If things feel urgent, use Support. It is always at the top of the screen.
empty: What's on your mind? Type, tap the mic, or pick one of these.
fixed: Fixed reply, not written by AI
inputHint: Enter to send, Shift+Enter for a new line.
tooLong: Shorten your message to {max} characters or fewer.
notHelpfulLabel: Mark this reply as not helpful

save.title: Saving
save.off: Off. Nothing is stored. The conversation disappears when you leave this screen.
save.on: On. Saved to your account, encrypted, for {days} days. Then deleted.

error: The chat could not be started.

voice.title: Voice
voice.readAloudHint: Replies to anything you say with Talk are always read aloud. Every reply is also shown as text.
voice.privacy: Talk uses your browser's speech service. In Chrome or Edge, what you say is sent to Google or Microsoft to be turned into text. This app never records or keeps audio. Replies are spoken by your device.
voice.unsupported: Talking needs Chrome or Edge. You can still type, and replies can be read aloud.

errors.not-allowed: The microphone is blocked. Allow it in your browser's site settings to use Talk.
errors.no-speech: Nothing was heard. Tap Talk and try again.
errors.network: The speech service could not be reached. You can type instead.
errors.other: Talk stopped unexpectedly. You can try again or type instead.

subtitle: Your AI companion
aiLine: Sushi is an AI, not a therapist. Nobody monitors this chat. In an emergency, use SOS Support.
face: Sushi, a black cat in an orange beanie and round glasses
faceTalking: Sushi, a black cat in an orange beanie, speaking

context.toggle: Let Sushi know about my wellbeing
context.off: Off. Sushi knows nothing about your check-ins, triggers or plan.
context.on: On. Sushi sees a short summary: check-ins and sleep from the last 14 days, your triggers, recent hard moments, and your safety plan's warning signs and coping steps. Never the people in your plan, your Vent entries or your contacts.
context.empty: Nothing yet: add a check-in, a trigger or your safety plan.
context.planTitle: That's on your trigger list ({trigger}). Your coping steps:
context.planEmpty: You haven't added coping steps to your safety plan yet.
